title: LEAF: LUT-aware Efficient Attention on FPGAs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Lookup-table (LUT)-aware Efficient Attention on FPGAs (LEAF). LEAF is the first nanosecond-scale LUT-aware transformer for FPGAs. Deploying transformers that are large enough to perform well, small enough to fit on an FPGA, and fast enough to meet the sub-microsecond timescales required by real-time systems such as those at CERN remains difficult, since the same attention mechanism that gives these models their high expressivity also makes them costly to implement in hardware. LEAF converts the query, key, and value projections and the final output feed-forward layer into FPGA-native layers with LUT-aware training, creating the first LUT-aware transformer and linformer layers built for ultra-low-latency inference. Attention resists LUT-aware training because it multiplies two activations where the method needs a constant weight to tabulate; LEAF tabulates the attention block's constant matrix-vector multiplications and leave

translated_title: LEAF：面向FPGA的查找表感知高效注意力机制
translated_abstract: 我们提出了面向FPGA的查找表（LUT）感知高效注意力机制（LEAF）。LEAF是首个纳秒级、查找表感知的FPGA transformer。部署既要足够大以保证良好性能、又要足够小以适配FPGA、还要足够快以满足CERN等实时系统所要求的亚微秒时间尺度的transformer仍然十分困难，因为赋予这些模型高表达能力的注意力机制同时也使其在硬件实现上成本高昂。LEAF通过查找表感知训练，将查询、键、值投影以及最终输出的前馈层转换为FPGA原生层，创建了首个为超低延迟推理而构建的查找表感知transformer和linformer层。注意力机制之所以难以进行查找表感知训练，是因为该方法需要常量权重来进行制表，而注意力机制涉及两个激活值之间的相乘；LEAF对注意力块中的常量矩阵-向量乘法进行制表，从而解决了这一问题。
tldr: LEAF是首个面向FPGA的纳秒级查找表感知transformer，通过将注意力块中的常量矩阵-向量乘法制表化，实现了满足实时系统要求的超低延迟推理。
en_tdlr: LEAF is the first nanosecond-scale LUT-aware transformer for FPGAs, achieving ultra-low-latency inference for real-time systems by tabulating the attention block's constant matrix-vector multiplications.
